page_title: PIS 0-1 ROM | Pisa v AS Roma 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Henrik Meister (Pisa) sees a yellow card from Giuseppe Collu after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+1' The game has come to an end for Matias Soule. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Neil El Aynaoui (AS Roma).
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch for Angelino.

90+1' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Mile Svilar thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
88' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) makes a strong challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul. AS Roma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
88' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Giuseppe Collu saw the whole situation. AS Roma have a free kick.
84' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
83' That will be all from Samuele Angori who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).
83' Alberto Gilardino prepares a substitution. Marius Marin is replaced by Calvin Stengs (Pisa).
83' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Angelino (AS Roma) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
82' Substitution. Mario Hermoso makes his way off the pitch and Zeki Celik (AS Roma) comes on as his replacement.

79' What a wasted opportunity by Wesley Franca (AS Roma)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Adrian Semper makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
78' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to AS Roma.
75' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
73' Substitution. Evan Ferguson walks off the pitch and Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) comes on as a substitute.
72' AS Roma can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
70' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Pisa.
66' It looked like the long-range shot by Michel Aebischer (Pisa) would end up in the net, but the effort went slightly over the bar. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.
66' The referee blows his whistle as Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) was too aggressive in his challenge. AS Roma earn a free kick.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Stefano Moreo walks off the pitch to be replaced by M'Bala Nzola (Pisa).
64' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Matteo Tramoni will be replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
64' Mateus Lusuardi goes off the pitch and Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) comes on.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
63' The AS Roma players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Giuseppe Collu signals NO GOAL following the VAR review.
63' Wait! Referee Giuseppe Collu has indicated he is going to review the AS Roma goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
61' Goal! Matias Soule (AS Roma) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
59' Matias Soule (AS Roma) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Pisa comes to nothing.
55' 0 - 1 Matias Soule (AS Roma) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
54' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
54' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
52' Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Manu Kone (AS Roma). Pisa get a free kick.
48' Manu Kone (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Pisa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) and Stephan El Shaarawy is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
42' Mateus Lusuardi (Pisa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Giuseppe Collu no option but to blow his whistle.

39' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. There is a free kick near the sideline to Pisa.
33' A yellow card for a tackle by Evan Ferguson (AS Roma). Giuseppe Collu doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
32' Marius Marin (Pisa) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Giuseppe Collu ignores the protests.

32' The game is interrupted. Marius Marin (Pisa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to AS Roma.
30' Giuseppe Collu couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) and blew his whistle. Pisa earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
26' Henrik Meister (Pisa) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! AS Roma are awarded a free kick.
26' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
22' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle. Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick to AS Roma.
21' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
19' The game is interrupted now, Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
17' Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul after Henrik Meister (Pisa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. AS Roma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
12' The linesman raises his flag. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
11' Henrik Meister (Pisa) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.

8' Henrik Meister (Pisa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Mile Svilar shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.

5' It looks like Marius Marin (Pisa) saw red with that tackle. Giuseppe Collu won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. It's a free kick to AS Roma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
5' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
4' Matias Soule (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! AS Roma will take the kick-off.
Giuseppe Collu will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
